svg.title: Partita No. 1, BWV 825, bars 1–6: source-defined voices in colour
svg.desc: J. S. Bach, Partita No. 1, BWV 825, I. Praeludium, bars 1–6. Typeset by Carl Bolstad, based on Bach-Gesellschaft; Mutopia-2006/08/21-474. The typesetter dedicated this edition to the public domain. Excerpt and three-part separation adapted from the source LilyPond/MIDI. Coloured study engraving re-typeset from the same LilyPond source with per-Voice colours; staff crossings, note spelling, rests, ties and printed ornaments preserved. Layout and voice labels adapted for the selected passage.
